notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying {R}.
Skirk Prospector enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
Reckless Barbarian enters the battlefield, triggering Paleoloth, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
